title: color-map find-contrast
description: Find the color closest in lightness to a background that reaches a WCAG 2 contrast target

target.description: The contrast ratio to reach, 1 to 21

hue.description: OKLCH hue of the result in degrees (default: the background's hue)

chroma.description: OKLCH chroma of the result (default 0, a gray)

full.description: Show the complete output instead of truncating it
